topic: Someone discovers their friend has been lying about their job
text: I found out today that Alex has been spinning a tale about his job, a yarn so thick I couldn't help but get tangled in it. We've been friends for years, and all this time, I believed he was climbing the corporate ladder at some high-flying firm. Turns out, he's been driving a delivery van. I don't know why, but I feel the weight of this secret between us, like a stone in my stomach. I want to confront him, to ask why he felt the need to weave such complexities into our friendship. Yet, part of me is afraid of what that might mean for us. Maybe it's better to let it lie, to pretend I still believe in the story he told.
